messages:
Jamie: Heads up — we might need to cut the live demo. AV is showing a weird echo on the stream. Starting all-hands in 6.
ops-bot: :loud_sound: Stream health alert: RTMP ingest latency spike (us-east-1) — retrying...
Chris: I'm at the AV console, seeing repeated keyframe drops. Switching to backup encoder in 30s.
VideoOps: Trying HDMI loopback as fallback. If it fails, we should record locally and upload to Drive. @Jamie @Sung
Sung: Thanks. Quick agenda note — I'll move roadmap deep-dive to after Q&A if we run over. Keep leadership updates earlier.
Maria: Can leadership still do the 5-min roadmap teaser now? I have a few product questions to ask live.
Alex: If we flip to local recording, remind folks to unmute in Zoom; we can't stitch audio later if we lose separate tracks.
Chris: Switched encoders. Still seeing micro-stutters but audio lock is good. Pasting logs:
```
[00:12:45] encoder0: keyframe-interval=2s
[00:12:48] encoder0: dropped_frame=3
[00:12:50] encoder1(backup): started, bitrate=4.5Mbps
```
VideoOps: backup encoder stable. Stream will reattach in ~15s. Start Q&A when I say go.
Jamie: Ok go ahead. @Lia please queue the first question and remind folks to keep them short.
Lia: On it. First q from @Maria: "Any changes to the Dedicated SLA rollout date?"
Sung: No change to SLA timeline — still aiming for June. More detail in the roadmap segment later.
Maria: Cool, thanks. Also — will the June rollout include the new batching heuristics?
Sung: Yes, that's part of the same release window. We'll surface the perf numbers in the postmortem doc.
Alex: Local recording running at /recordings/allhands-2026-03-23.mp4 — I'm starting the upload after the call.
Jamie: Appreciated. If the live VOD is delayed, we'll post the local recording + short summary in #announcements within 2 hours.
ops-bot: :white_check_mark: Stream recovered (ingest latency normalized). Live stream back.
Maria: Perfect :party_parrot: 
Jamie: Thanks everyone. Quick run-through of Q&A queue in 30s.
